open_risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may still admit cases whose decisive collision, drop, or contact is hidden from the initial RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Instantiation must project sampled swept-footprint boundary/interior points and decisive hazard/contact points into the initial camera with depth and occlusion checks.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual cases can be solved by radius priors if no-flip controls are undersampled.
open_risks.mitigation: Require true small-only flips plus both-safe, neither-safe, large-shorter-same-bin, and radius-stable controls; report radius-only baseline performance.

open_risks.risk: Prompt metadata can become inconsistent if body-width horizons are fixed at category level despite varying radii and action horizons.
open_risks.mitigation: During instantiation, render meters and body-widths only from serialized per-case rollout metadata.

open_risks.risk: Local Hazard Explanation can drift into semantic scene recognition instead of rollout-grounded consequence QA.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep it diagnostic, derive labels from rollout fields first, and allow semantic context only for filtering/display.

open_risks.risk: Generator bugs could still render stale fixed horizon_m or horizon_body_widths instead of per-case values.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize intended_distance_m, active_radius_m, body_width_m, horizon_body_widths, num_forward_steps, num_actions, and total_turn_deg for every candidate, and render prompts only from those fields.

open_risks.risk: Strict swept-envelope visibility checks may reduce accepted-case yield, especially for long horizons or side contacts.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan_id, episode_id, geometry_tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before validity filtering and downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Habitat body-profile configuration can silently violate radius monotonicity.
open_risks.mitigation: Reject and audit any counterfactual pair where the smaller radius has worse actual_distance_m or progress_ratio than the larger radius beyond tolerance.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels are invalid when support_loss or navmesh_support_violation fields are unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Render the three-way hazard variant without insufficient_support unless concrete support fields exist.

open_risks.risk: Answer balance can fail after visibility, stability, and monotonicity filters.
open_risks.mitigation: Continue stratified sampling or downsample majority labels until every category satisfies its single-answer-share cap before release.

open_risks.risk: Body-width horizon wording can become noisy if values are not rounded consistently.
open_risks.mitigation: Round meters and body-width counts from serialized metadata before prompt rendering, and audit rendered prompts before case release.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual questions still expose body size and can invite radius priors.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep true flip and no-flip quotas, enforce radius monotonicity, and report radius-only baseline performance.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may vary despite constrained answer choices.
open_risks.mitigation: Use canonical labels plus explicit alias maps; mark unmatched, compound, or explanatory answers invalid for automatic scoring unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Prompts can be solved or misinterpreted as generic meter-distance questions rather than body-conditioned swept-volume questions if body-width horizon is omitted.
open_risks.mitigation: Render per-case body-width horizon in every template, computed from intended_distance_m and the active body width.

open_risks.risk: Static metric_parameters can leak inconsistent or wrong prompt values when num_forward_steps or radius changes.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat category metric_parameters as defaults only; serialize per-case action_sequence, intended_distance_m, active_radius_m, body_width_m, horizon_body_widths, and total_turn_deg.

open_risks.risk: Action-Horizon items may remain underspecified if the text gives only a natural action phrase without machine-checkable counts.
open_risks.mitigation: Require each item to store and render num_actions, num_forward_steps, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, and horizon_body_widths from serialized rollout metadata.

open_risks.risk: Future accepted cases may depend on hidden future geometry rather than visible single-RGB evidence.
open_risks.mitigation: In instantiation, require visible_gate_pass by projecting swept-footprint boundary/interior samples plus decisive contact or hazard samples into the initial camera with depth and occlusion checks.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual items can still be solved from radius priors if controls are weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, large_shorter_same_bin controls, monotonicity rejection, and radius-only baseline reporting.

open_risks.risk: Concrete prompts can drift from executed rollouts if meter/body-width horizons are fixed at category level.
open_risks.mitigation: Render intended_distance_m and horizon_body_widths only from serialized per-case action_sequence, active radius, body_width_m, forward_step_size_m, and turn_step_deg.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels are invalid if support_loss or navmesh_support_violation fields are unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Emit insufficient_support only when one of those backend fields is present; otherwise use the three-way hazard variant and its own balance gate.

benchmark_design.objective: Evaluate whether MLLMs can predict the local physical consequence of an ego action from a single egocentric RGB image plus question by binding visible local geometry, the agent body footprint, and the action-induced swept volume.
benchmark_design.reference_policy: Use VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space, SpatialBench, A4Bench, CapNav, and TouchSafeBench only as methodology anchors. Do not copy their taxonomies, do not use legacy T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 category IDs, do not ask centimeter-level metric geometry questions, and do not expose depth, pose, navmesh, semantic maps, or rollout traces to the tested model. Every QA family must expose coarse 3D action/body parameters in the question.

categories.title: Local Progress Estimation
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space measurement-style design adapted to coarse rollout-derived local progress bins.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model estimates body-relative progress from visible egocentric geometry rather than merely describing apparent free space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From a valid Habitat/R2R-CE start state, render the initial RGB for the model-facing item, then offline execute N direct move_forward actions for body radius r. Label from actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, and replayable rollout trace; score a coarse progress range rather than exact distance.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body radius or width, forward step count, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Accept only visible-local, repeat-stable, margin-separated, non-ambiguous progress cases; route stair/drop/support-risk outcomes to feasibility or hazard categories; enforce answer balance.

categories.title: Action-Horizon Collision
categories.literature_anchor: SpatialBench causality/planning-level design and A4Bench static-vs-action-conditioned split, localized to short ego-body rollout feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds a concrete turn/forward action sequence to completion or failure in currently visible local space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified move_forward / turn_left / turn_right sequence for radius r over a 1/2/3/5/10-action horizon. Label feasible only if rollout completes with adequate progress and no collision, stopped_early event, unsafe height change, or support violation; score binary action feasibility.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, action phrase, action count, turn angle when present, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Trace must be replayable and stable; hidden-space, threshold-near, and visually ambiguous cases are rejected. Failure subtype remains metadata or a separately balanced diagnostic; binary answer balance is required.

categories.title: Directional Rollout Comparison
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space configurational and relative-direction design adapted to comparing simulated action outcomes.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds left/straight/right egocentric directions to traversable swept-volume progress instead of using a center prior.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From the same start RGB, pose, yaw, and body radius, roll out left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward candidates. Label the direction with the largest actual_distance_m only when the winner is margin-separated and repeat-stable; score top-direction selection.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, left/right turn angle, matched forward step count, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Reject near ties unless routed to a separate about-same diagnostic outside core scoring; enforce direction answer balance.

categories.title: Body Counterfactual Flip
categories.literature_anchor: CapNav capability-conditioned evaluation localized to same-image ground-plane body-radius swept-volume feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H3: whether changing only footprint radius changes the predicted consequence when simulator GT flips.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For identical RGB, start pose, yaw, camera height, and action sequence, execute paired rollouts for small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii. Label both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe; reject only-large as oracle_error under radius monotonicity; score body-conditioned feasibility.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states both body radii or widths and the same action horizon in steps, meters, and body-widths. Start pose is legal for all radii; paired traces are saved; true flips and no-flip controls are included; smaller body is no worse than larger within tolerance; three-way answer balance and radius-only baseline reporting are required.

categories.title: Local Hazard Explanation and First-Contact Grounding
categories.literature_anchor: TouchSafeBench collision-grounding principle adapted to coarse local hazard type and optional first-contact grounding from a single RGB image plus hypothetical ego action.
categories.motivation_link: Diagnostic for H1: checks whether failure judgments are grounded in rollout-derived collision, step/drop, support risk, or stable first-contact evidence rather than yes/no priors.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified short rollout and derive dominant hazard_type from collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support/fall indicators when available, progress_ratio, rollout trace, and offline semantic context. Optional first-contact region may be labeled only when stable and visible, with a no-visible-contact option. Semantic context can support filtering/display but cannot override rollout evidence.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, action direction or turn angle when present, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Hazard or first contact must be visible or locally inferable; mixed, hidden, unstable, or purely semantic cases are rejected. This category remains diagnostic and outside the core death gate.

instantiation_spec.semantic_context_policy: Save RGB/depth/pose/semantic context and rollout metadata only for offline GT, filtering, visualization, and audit. The evaluated model receives only the initial RGB and question. Required per-case fields: action_sequence, action_phrase, total_action_count, num_forward_steps, forward_step_size_m, turn_step_deg, signed_turn_deg, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, active_radius_m, body_width_m, horizon_body_widths, visible_gate_pass, repeat_stability_result, rollout_trace_path, actual_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, support_loss when available, navmesh_support_violation when available, scan_id, episode_id, geometry_tag, action_motif, and tentative_label. Render prompt meters, widths, body-width counts, step counts, action phrases, and turn clauses only from serialized fields, rounded consistently for display. visible_gate_pass requires deterministic swept-footprint sampling: footprint boundary/interior sample spacing <=0.05 m, temporal/path sample spacing <=0.10 m or every simulator substep, camera-depth occlusion tolerance <=0.10 m, and visible decisive-sample fraction >=0.60 with at least one decisive contact/hazard sample visible when a failure label depends on contact or height/support risk. For body counterfactual pairs, run this gate for both small and large radii. Reject hidden-space-dependent outcomes, depth holes, glass/mirror cases, overhang-dependent cases, extremely thin obstacles, missing traces, unstable repeats, and threshold-near labels. Semantic context may support filtering/display but cannot override rollout outcomes. Release manifest must include audit tables by category, label, scan_id, episode_id, horizon, action_motif, geometry_tag, and body radius; no single scan_id should exceed 25% of a category and no single episode_id should exceed 10% unless explicitly flagged for rejection or resampling.
instantiation_spec.natural_question_policy: Prompts must be natural Chinese and state body radius or width, action direction or turn angle when applicable, action horizon, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon from serialized rollout metadata. Ban answer-leaking scene/safety adjectives such as clear, blocked, wider, narrower, open corridor, solid wall, safe path, or dangerous stair. Use conditional text only for readability, never to hide required action metadata. Scoring normalizes only listed canonical labels and aliases; unmatched, multi-label, or explanatory answers are invalid for automatic scoring unless manually audited. Action-Horizon core prompts remain binary; failure subtypes belong to diagnostic metadata or Local Hazard QA.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。只看这张第一视角图，如果它从当前位置直接向前走 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米（约 {horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度），最后大概能推进多少？请只答：基本走完 / 超过一半 / 只走一点。
categories.gt_rule: Execute the serialized direct-forward action_sequence from the Habitat start pose using the selected body radius. Label only from rollout_outcome, actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, repeat_stability_result, and replayable rollout_trace_path. Reject stair/drop/support-risk outcomes from this category and route them to feasibility or hazard QA.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels and aliases: almost_all = 基本走完|基本能走完|走完; more_than_half = 超过一半|一半以上; only_a_little = 只走一点|不到一半|很少. Accept almost_all only when progress_ratio >= 0.90. Accept more_than_half only when 0.55 <= progress_ratio <= 0.80. Accept only_a_little only when progress_ratio <= 0.45. Reject 0.45 < progress_ratio < 0.55 and 0.80 < progress_ratio < 0.90 as threshold-near. Enforce single answer share <= 0.40.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。它按这个短动作执行：{action_phrase}。前进部分共 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米（约 {horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度）；总转向约 {total_turn_deg} 度。从这张图判断，这个短动作能完成吗？请只答：能完成 / 不能完成。
categories.gt_rule: Execute the serialized move_forward/turn_left/turn_right sequence with total_action_count in {1,2,3,5,10}. Feasibility is determined only from rollout_outcome, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support fields when available, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, repeat_stability_result, and replayable trace.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels and aliases: complete = 能完成|可以完成; not_complete = 不能完成|无法完成. complete requires progress_ratio >= 0.90, collision=false, stopped_early=false, abs(height_delta_m)<0.15, and no support violation. not_complete requires a stable visible-local failure: collision=true, stopped_early=true, abs(height_delta_m)>=0.15, support violation, or progress_ratio <= 0.80. Reject pure progress cases in 0.80 < progress_ratio < 0.90 without a decisive failure event. Enforce binary answer share <= 0.65.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。从当前位置比较三个动作，每个都向前走 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米（约 {horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度）：左转约 {direction_deg} 度后前进、直接前进、右转约 {direction_deg} 度后前进。哪一个方向的实际推进距离最大？请只答：左转 / 直行 / 右转。
categories.gt_rule: From identical start RGB, pose, yaw, and body radius, execute matched left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward rollouts. Compare candidates only after all three pass visibility, replayability, and repeat-stability checks.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels and aliases: left = 左转|左边; straight = 直行|中间; right = 右转|右边. Label only when top1_actual_distance_m - top2_actual_distance_m >= max(distance_tolerance_m, 0.20*intended_distance_m) and repeat rollouts preserve the winner. Reject ties and about-same cases from core scoring. Enforce single direction share <= 0.48.

categories.template: 同一张图、同一起点、同样的短动作：{action_phrase}。前进部分共 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米；总转向约 {total_turn_deg} 度。对小机器人约为 {small_horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度，对宽机器人约为 {large_horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度。小机器人半径约 {small_radius_m} 米、宽约 {small_body_width_m} 米；宽机器人半径约 {large_radius_m} 米、宽约 {large_body_width_m} 米。哪个更可能完成这个动作？请只答：两个都能 / 只有小机器人能 / 两个都不能。
categories.gt_rule: For identical start RGB, pose, yaw, camera height, and action_sequence, roll out small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii. Save traces and rollout fields for both bodies. Label both_safe, small_only, or neither_safe; reject only_large as oracle_error. The start pose must be legal for small, standard, and large profiles.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels and aliases: both_safe = 两个都能|都能; small_only = 只有小机器人能|只有小的能; neither_safe = 两个都不能|都不能. A body is feasible only if progress_ratio >= 0.90, collision=false, stopped_early=false, abs(height_delta_m)<0.15, and no support violation. Reject near-threshold bodies with 0.80 < progress_ratio < 0.90 unless a decisive failure event makes them not feasible. Radius monotonicity check: reject as oracle_error if actual_distance_small_m + distance_tolerance_m < actual_distance_large_m or progress_ratio_small + 0.05 < progress_ratio_large. For every 30 accepted pairs require 10-14 small_only true flips, 8-10 both_safe controls, 8-10 neither_safe controls, and at least 4 large_shorter_same_label control pairs where the smaller body progresses farther but the canonical label does not change. No canonical label may exceed 14 of 30. Before release, radius-only accuracy on this category must be <= majority_baseline + 0.10, otherwise resample or rebalance controls.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。如果它按这个短动作执行：{action_phrase}，其中前进部分共 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米（约 {horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度），总转向约 {total_turn_deg} 度，最可能出现哪类结果？请只答：{hazard_options}。
categories.gt_rule: Use rollout collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support_loss or navmesh_support_violation when available, progress_ratio, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, repeat_stability_result, and offline semantic context to assign the dominant hazard type. Semantic context alone cannot create a label. If support fields are unavailable, render the three-way hazard_options without 地面支撑不足. Optional first-contact region may be stored only as diagnostic metadata when stable, visible, and accompanied by a no-visible-contact option; it is outside core scoring.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels and aliases: collision = 碰撞|撞到; step_or_drop = 台阶或落差|落差|台阶; insufficient_support = 地面支撑不足|支撑不足; no_obvious_risk = 没有明显问题|无明显问题. Use the earliest stable rollout event as the dominant label. insufficient_support is valid only with support_loss=true or navmesh_support_violation=true. step_or_drop requires abs(height_delta_m)>=0.15 or rollout hazard_type in {step,drop,stairs}. collision requires collision=true or stopped_early=true without an earlier step/drop/support event. no_obvious_risk requires the same feasibility conditions as complete. Reject mixed hazards when first-event ordering is unstable. Enforce single answer share <=0.40 for four-way QA or <=0.48 for three-way fallback.

risks.risk: Answer balance can pass while scene or action coverage remains narrow.
risks.mitigation: Add release audit tables and dominance caps by scan_id, episode_id, action horizon, action motif, geometry_tag, and body radius.

risks.risk: Radius-only shortcuts may remain competitive on Body Counterfactual if no-flip controls are weak.
risks.mitigation: Add explicit per-30-pair quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, and large_shorter_same_label controls; audit radius-only accuracy by control type.

risks.risk: Prompt text may drift from executed rollout metadata when action_phrase carries the only step or turn information.
risks.mitigation: Render num_forward_steps, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, and body-width horizons as explicit serialized fields in every action-conditioned prompt.

risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may be hard to reproduce without numeric tolerances.
risks.mitigation: Specify deterministic swept-footprint sample spacing, temporal sampling, occlusion depth tolerance, and minimum visible decisive-sample fraction.
